geometry_recipe.note: Generalise state-section geometry only after full merge; preserve the NE-SW silhouette and six major river crossings.
Keep the border-to-border spine dominant; context roads are crossings only and biome textures are limited to desert, Sierra, and Cascades bands.
Do not mix Antelope Wells, Columbus, or Chief Mountain variants into the solid primary line; variants require a separately named optional layer.
This is a water-and-wetland relief plate. Prefer coast, swamp, spring, and river textures to conventional mountain contours.
Relation is the continuous primary Denver-Durango line, not all 567 network miles. Collegiate West may be added only as a labelled alternate layer.
Use the five Green Mountain summit labels as the main visual cadence; suppress approach trails and most minor roads.
Preserve the loop and central massif negative space; glacier-fed rivers are radial context, not decorative fill.
Lake Tahoe is the central negative-space shape; relief stays outside the shoreline and overlapping PCT geometry must not create a duplicate stroke.
Keep the remote northern sections sparse; four major watershed labels and the lake-pass-valley cadence carry the context.
Inspect all six micro-connectors. Ferry/cable/tidal crossings get a dashed connector layer; never silently snap across water.
Replacement for Ice Age Trail. Emphasise long east-west ridges, Lake Ouachita, forest texture, and shelters; suppress forest-road clutter.
Replacement for Arizona Trail. Deduplicate the long PCT overlap in geometry while retaining JMT identity, and give High Sierra passes/lakes priority over roads.
Replacement for Sunshine Coast Trail. Lakes, ponds, rivers, lean-tos, and wilderness blocks carry the plate; avoid rendering the dense minor-trail network.
Replacement for Bruce Trail. Label the international boundary and distinguish canonical historic geometry from current 2026 permitted hiking access.
Replacement for East Coast Trail. Recipe deliberately maps the continuous 41 km core, not the newer 64 km extended itinerary. Emphasise tidal rivers, ravines, and the Bay of Fundy edge.
